title: How 7 Prompts Turn ChatGPT Into Your DSA Tutor
subtitle: You don't need another tutorial — you need an AI that adapts to you.
intro: You watched the same DSA tutorial 3 times and still got stuck on the code. What if you could ask it to explain it your way instead?
takeaway: Prompt engineering turns a general AI into a personal tutor that adapts to your level, mistakes, and pace.

sections.heading: Analogy: personal trainer vs. YouTube workout
sections.body:
A tutorial is like a YouTube workout video. It plays the same for everyone.

A good prompt is like telling a personal trainer: "I'm a beginner, my knees hurt, go slow." Prompt engineering means writing clear instructions so the AI knows your level, your goal, and how to teach you.

That shift is why the next idea matters.

sections.heading: Why it exists: tutorials can't adapt to you
sections.body:
Tutorials teach everyone the same way. An AI tutor can adapt to your pace, your mistakes, and your gaps.

With 7 prompts from your save, you can ask for concept intuition, problem breakdown, pattern recognition, debugging, and time and space complexity help.

You learn by thinking, not just watching. But personal doesn't mean perfect.

sections.heading: What can go wrong: when your tutor hallucinates
sections.body:
An AI tutor can sound confident and still be wrong. It can give you a buggy solution, a fake pattern, or an inefficient answer.

If you copy without testing edge cases or checking complexity, you learn the mistake.

Use prompts to ask "why" and "show me a test case," not just "give me the code."

steps.narration: You start with your specific level and stuck point.
You write a prompt that tells the AI how to teach you.
ChatGPT adapts its explanation to you, not everyone.
You get intuition, breakdown, and practice at your pace.
You test the answer for bugs and complexity before trusting it.

options: Writing clear instructions so AI teaches at your level

quiz.q: Why does personalized AI tutoring exist instead of just tutorials?
options: Tutorials teach everyone the same way and can't adapt
quiz.why: The save says tutorials teach everyone the same way, while ChatGPT teaches you personally.

quiz.q: What can go wrong if you trust the AI tutor blindly?
options: It will always give optimal time and space complexity
It can confidently give buggy or inefficient code you then memorize
quiz.why: AI can hallucinate wrong solutions, so you must test edge cases and verify complexity.
